aiExplanation.summary: This file registers selection-aware commands for opening Line and Section user-note editors.
aiExplanation.detail:
- registerAddNoteCommands: Registers the commands and keeps their editor-context availability current.
- addLineNote: Opens a Line Note editor for the active source line.
- addSectionNote: Captures the selected Store and range, then asks NotesViewProvider to open an unsaved Section draft.
